cases.detail: registry examples parse, validate, and keep their original spelling
TEI comparison is case-sensitive and does not rewrite the domain
highest equal version is ordered by priority, with the normative example
an empty discovery array is not a successful resolution
an unknown error string still identifies a TEA error and is not a failover trigger
a mismatched checksum is not reported as verified
a SHA-1-only match is Weak, not Verified, unless the caller opts in
